name: nutrition-tracker
description: Private nutrition tracking with automatic assumptions and UI-only responses.

interface.longDescription: Turn meal photos, voice notes, restaurant orders, and plain-language descriptions into automatically logged nutrition entries. The plugin makes reasonable assumptions, asks only when truly blocked, and uses its embedded UI as the complete answer. See every ingredient, correct meals afterward in natural language, reuse favorite meals, and track calories, protein, macros, fiber, and weight trends.
defaultPrompt: Log this meal using reasonable assumptions and return only the Nutrition Tracker UI.
Change the rice in my last meal to two cups and return only the updated UI.
Show today's Nutrition Tracker UI with no prose.
